verdict.rationale: Ashby's AI can scan existing candidates in aggregate for rediscovery. Ashby Assistant can 'take action across Ashby' (update candidates, draft emails), with custom agents for repeated workflows. The API supports paginated and sync-token list retrieval, which allows bulk reads, but nothing documents a true bulk-write or batch-action capability. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch actions on many records at once (UI or agent), batch API write endpoints, and hands-on corroboration that the Assistant can act on many items in one operation.
